permissions.label: Approval mode
permissions.title: How should AlphaCode request approval?
permissions.busy: Approval mode can be changed after this task finishes
permissions.unavailable: Approval mode is unavailable until the session is ready
permissions.saveFailed: Could not confirm the permission change. Check the current mode and try again.
permissions.help: This setting applies only to this session and syncs with the CLI. Ask for approval and Auto approval allow workspace file tools and block custom tools. Auto approval only approves predefined routine commands. Full access skips tool approval within the permissions of the AlphaCode process; it does not grant additional system access.

ask.name: Ask for approval
ask.description: Ask before running commands; allow workspace file tools

auto.name: Auto approval
auto.description: Auto-approve predefined routine commands; ask before other commands

full.name: Full access
full.description: Allow all tools and commands with current process permissions
